vision: Um ecossistema digital fullstack para geração de interfaces de altíssima fidelidade, performance extrema e acessibilidade total por IA, construindo uma empresa de milhões de dólares.

stack.state_management: React Context / Zustand (for global states) / Server Actions

stack.framework: Standard Library + chi (router) / gin (for rapid development)
stack.database_orm: PostgreSQL (direct SQL / sqlc for type-safe queries)
stack.authentication: JWT (JSON Web Tokens) with Refresh Tokens
stack.security: AES-256 for sensitive data at rest, HTTPS (TLS 1.3), OWASP best practices, CSRF/XSS protection via API design

backend.deployment: Containerized (Docker) on Cloud Provider (e.g., GCP Cloud Run, AWS ECS, DigitalOcean App Platform)
core_services: Project Service (AI-generated projects management - placeholder for core AI logic)
Plan/Billing Service (Subscription plans, payment integration - placeholder)
backend.data_storage_strategy: PostgreSQL (primary data persistence), Redis (session caching, API response caching)
backend.error_handling: Centralized, structured error responses with specific error codes and messages.

ai_core_integration.description: The 'AI Web Weaver' core logic will be integrated as a dedicated service (within the Go backend or as a separate microservice). For initial phases, this will be represented by placeholder endpoints in the Project Service.

security_posture: Zero Trust (Authentication and Authorization at every layer, least privilege)

observability.logging: Structured logs (JSON format) with correlation IDs
observability.alerting: Integrated with monitoring for critical events

development_methodology: Test-Driven Development (TDD), Code Reviews, CI/CD pipelines.
